# Afterkeep

> Independent guide to digital legacy: what happens to online accounts, photos, passwords and crypto when someone dies, plus verdicts on legacy tools. General information, not legal advice.

## Platforms
- [What happens to my Google / Gmail when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/google-gmail/): Google never hands over passwords. If you set up Inactive Account Manager, up to 10 people you chose can download the data you picked once y
- [What happens to my Google Photos when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/google-photos/): Google Photos lives inside your Google Account, so it follows Google's rules. Add Photos to Inactive Account Manager and your chosen contact
- [What happens to my Apple iCloud when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/apple-icloud/): With a Legacy Contact, that person uses their access key and your death certificate to request your iCloud data, such as photos, messages, n
- [What happens to my Facebook when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/facebook/): Facebook either memorialises your profile, adding 'Remembering' next to your name, or permanently deletes it, depending on what you chose in
- [What happens to my Instagram when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/instagram/): Instagram memorialises an account when it receives proof of death, such as an obituary. Nobody can log into a memorialised account, and its 
- [What happens to my X (Twitter) when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/x-twitter/): X doesn't memorialise accounts and won't give anyone access, including family. An immediate family member or a person authorised to act for 
- [What happens to my Microsoft / Outlook when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/microsoft-outlook/): Microsoft won't release a deceased person's Outlook.com or OneDrive content without a valid subpoena or court order, and even then it isn't 
- [What happens to my LinkedIn when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/linkedin/): LinkedIn offers two options: close the account or memorialise the profile. Anyone connected or related by last name can report a member as d
- [What happens to my Crypto exchanges (Coinbase) when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/coinbase/): Crypto held on Coinbase forms part of your estate. Coinbase doesn't support beneficiary designations for individual accounts, so heirs need 
- [What happens to my Dropbox when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/dropbox/): Dropbox may give access to a deceased person's files, but only after reviewing proof of death and a valid court order showing you have a leg
- [What happens to my WhatsApp when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/whatsapp/): WhatsApp doesn't memorialise accounts or offer a legacy contact. Accounts are generally deleted after 365 days without connecting to WhatsAp
- [What happens to my YouTube when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/youtube/): YouTube channels belong to a Google Account, so Google's rules apply. With Inactive Account Manager you can share YouTube data with up to 10
- [What happens to my Amazon & Kindle library when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/amazon-kindle/): Amazon only shares account details or takes most actions for the authorised estate representative. If the account is closed, all purchased d
- [What happens to my PayPal when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/paypal/): PayPal only takes instructions from the authorised executor or administrator of the estate. In Australia, the executor emails PayPal a cover
- [What happens to my Steam when I die?](https://afterkeep.github.io/platforms/steam/): Steam games are licences, not property you own. The Steam Subscriber Agreement says your account is strictly personal and that accounts and 

## Tools
- [Bitwarden](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/bitwarden/): The best-value password manager with real emergency access: trusted contacts can request View or Takeover access after a wait time you set.
- [1Password](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/1password/): Excellent password manager, but it has no automatic emergency-access feature. Legacy planning relies on the Emergency Kit and family account recovery.
- [Keeper](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/keeper/): A solid choice with built-in Emergency Access: name trusted contacts who can request your vault after a wait period.
- [LastPass Emergency Access](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/lastpass-emergency-access/): It works: contacts can request vault access after a wait period. LastPass's 2022 security breaches are a good reason to look at alternatives first, though.
- [Dashlane](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/dashlane/): Not recommended for legacy access. Dashlane removed its Emergency Contact feature and now suggests sharing an exported vault file with a trusted person.
- [Google Inactive Account Manager](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/google-inactive-account-manager/): Free and essential if you use Google. Set it up today: after a period of inactivity you choose, Google notifies up to 10 people and can share selected data with them.
- [Apple Legacy Contact](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/apple-legacy-contact/): Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data.
- [Trust & Will](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/trust-and-will/): Popular online tool for US wills and trusts with guided questions. Not built for Australian or most non-US jurisdictions.
- [GoodTrust](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/goodtrust/): An all-in-one US estate planning platform: will, trust and directives (valid in all 50 states) plus a Digital Vault for your digital life.
- [Everplans](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/everplans/): A well-structured digital vault for life admin and end-of-life plans that you can securely share with people you trust.
- [Prisidio](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/prisidio/): A family 'life readiness' vault with a Co-Owner and a Keyholder who can get the vault after a verified death, with identity checks via CLEAR.
- [Casa](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/casa/): A leading multisig self-custody service with inheritance included in every plan, covering bitcoin, ETH and stablecoins.
- [Unchained](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/unchained/): Collaborative-custody Bitcoin vaults (2-of-3 multisig) with inheritance planning. Strong for larger holdings.
- [Vault12 Guard](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/vault12/): Backs up seed phrases using trusted 'Guardians' and lets you name a beneficiary who can inherit after a 48-hour owner veto window and Guardian approvals.
- [Ledger Recover](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/ledger-recover/): An optional, ID-based seed backup for Ledger hardware wallets. Handy for recovery, but it's a trust trade-off and isn't primarily an inheritance tool.
- [Proton Pass (Proton Emergency Access)](https://afterkeep.github.io/tools/proton-pass/): A solid privacy-first option: on any paid Proton plan you can name up to five emergency contacts who get access automatically after a wait time you choose, unless you deny the request.
